{{Quote|Quills! I didn't know there were any of you Spiners left in the Galaxy.|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 8">[[Star Wars (1977) 8|''Star Wars'' (1977) 8]]</ref>}}
'''Spiners''' were nearly-extinct bipedal sentient mammals with sharp quills. They were capable of hurling these with great speed and accuracy by flexing their muscles in a certain manner. Their native [[Planet/Legends|world]], [[Worxer]], was destroyed when its [[Star/Legends|sun]] went [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. The surviving population gradually became sterile for a lack of nutrients found exclusively in their home sector of [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood]].

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|I kinda hoped you'd be different&hellip; But I don't even see your gun.''"<br />"''My name is Hedji&hellip; And I never use one.|Han Solo and Hedji|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 8" />}}
Spiners were covered in stiff barbed quills, the longest of which grew on the arms and legs, and could reach a length of several [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]]. Spiners possessed the unique ability to propel these quills by simply flexing specific muscles, which could propel the quills with incredible speed and accuracy up to ten [[Meter/Legends|meters]] away.

Spiner quills themselves were extremely hard, as shown by [[Hedji]] when he attacked and killed a [[High-hound]], as well as several [[Cloud-Riders/Legends|Cloud-Riders]]&mdash;lending to the quills' ability to pierce skin, clothing, and light [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with sufficient force as to [[Death/Legends|kill]].

Spiners additionally had extremely quick metabolisms, and were capable of spontaneously growing more quills as needed; a Spiner could easily expend hundreds of quills during the course of a fight. Spiner names included Briss, Devik, Fifter, Firril, Jerrid, Meejen, Prikler, Toira, and Yaff.
